description: en-US disamb-examples replay on inline rules (marker handling, input/output forms, untouched, bad forms)

args.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rules lang="en">
<rule id="EX_OK" name="EX_OK"><pattern><token postag="DT" postag_regexp="yes"/><marker><token postag="NN.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></marker></pattern><disambig postag="NN"/><example type="ambiguous" inputform="dogs[dog/NNS]" outputform="dogs[dog/NN]">The <marker>dogs</marker> x</example><example type="untouched">I saw her duck under the table.</example><example type="ambiguous" inputform="a[a]" outputform="b[b]">The dogs run fast.</example><example type="ambiguous" inputform="a[a]" outputform="b[b]"><marker>The</marker> dogs run fast.</example><example type="untouched"> </example></rule>
<rule id="EX_ADD" name="EX_ADD"><pattern><token postag="NN.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="add"><wd lemma="ADDED" pos="XADD"/></disambig><example type="untouched">They can fish in the big lake.</example><example type="ambiguous" inputform="dogs[x]" outputform="dogs[y]">The <marker>dogs</marker></example></rule>
<rule id="EX_IMM" name="EX_IMM"><pattern><token postag="DT" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="NN.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="immunize"/><example type="untouched">The dogs run fast.</example><example type="untouched">Zz.</example></rule>
<rule id="EX_BAD_FORM" name="EX_BAD_FORM"><pattern><token postag="NN.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig postag="NN"/><example type="ambiguous" inputform="" outputform="x"><marker>They</marker></example><example type="ambiguous" inputform="[" outputform="]"><marker>They</marker></example></rule>
</rules>
